items.title: 5.1.1 Definition and Importance of Models (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Model kisi pecheeda masle ya soorat-e-haal ko saada andaaz se dekhne ka tareeqa hai jo samajhne, bayan karne ya andaza lagane mein madad deta hai ke cheezein kaise chalti hain, sab se aham hisson par tawajjo de kar aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor kar, jaise naqsha sarkein aur nishaniyan dikhata hai.
Student ka parhai ka mansooba model hai: yeh aham mazameen par tawajjo de kar aur kam aham kaam chhor kar schedule saada karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Asal duniya ke istemal mein statistical models banane ki kya ahmiyat hai (short question 1)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh data ko samajh aur pesh-goi mein badalte hain: rishte zahir karte, kamai ya mausam jaise nataij ka andaza lagate, aur karobar, sehat, zaraat aur tehqeeq mein faislon mein madad dete hain, aur batate hain ke pesh-goi kitni ghair yaqeeni hai.

items: Model: masle ka saada naqsha jo samajhne, bayan karne ya pesh-goi ke liye hai.
